name: Kamishiro Rushia
source:
Likes: People with pure hearts
Dislikes: Speaking only with words

The school's most well-known Yamato nadeshiko, who is very refined, kind and friendly. Despite her appearance, she is actually a foreigner and only acts like the ideal Japanese woman. In spite of her popularity, she likes being alone and is a bit weird as well. Due to her parents being away, she lives together with her older brother. She is exceptionally good at all kinds of housework.
